roles.calibration: temperature fit on the selected checkpoint
roles.test: locked final evaluation (official + newly reserved + held-out policy structures)
roles.showcase: compact benchmark/demo panel: official rows, variants (<source>.variant, same group id), held-out policy, hand-written support set
roles.unseen: eval-only panel from sources absent from training (PAWS, QNLI, Emotion)

limitations: Machine-translated Italian, not independently labelled native-Italian data.
Structural and number checks do not establish semantic equivalence.
Composition labels are verified from executable certificates; Italian uses one logic surface style.
Null choice descriptions expanded from stable IDs in both languages.
50/50 refers to records and training loss weight, not token counts.

corrections.is it illegal to have brass knuckles in: è illegale possedere un tirapugni in Canada?

review_postprocessing.rule: Exclude whole bilingual groups with verbatim English NLI hypotheses of at least four words; correct exact known schema translations; keep stable labels and states unchanged
